a245.title: Surf Band®
a245.body: Adjust key riding settings from your wrist, including surf side, speed and audio. Ask the team about compatible equipment.

a245.title: Axis Dash
a245.body: A touchscreen helm brings boat information and riding controls together. Explore presets, ballast settings and audio from the driver’s seat.

a245.title: Surf Gate®
a245.body: Switch the surf wave from one side to the other. Pair the system with Power Wedge III to adjust the shape of your ride.

a245.title: Monsoon Engines®
a245.body: Purpose-built towboat power from the Monsoon engine family. Confirm the engine options for your model and New Zealand order with the team.
